appearances.title: Xiaomi MiMo HySparse2 runs prompts through 25 of 49 layers: 5x less prefill, 4.5x smaller KV at 1M context
appearances.summary: SemiAnalysis reports Xiaomi's next MiMo models move to a causal encoder-decoder design where prompts pass through only 25 of 49 layers and decoder KV is projected from encoder states, cutting prefill compute about 5x and KV cache 4.5x at 1M context versus MiMo-V2.
